title: Switching failure probability
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates, let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The switching failure probability is the expected value, under the random restriction with parameter $\\delta$, of the switching failure indicator at threshold $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates
caveat: The formal statement relies on omitted definitions of the random restriction distribution and its expectation.
